about:
Pyramid Semiconductor is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. The company was formed in January 2003 through the acquisition of all product lines from Performance Semiconductor, continuing support for all previously supported parts under the same part numbering scheme. On March 8, 2021, HEICO Corporation's Electronic Technologies Group acquired Pyramid Semiconductor LLC, and the business now operates as part of HEICO/3D PLUS USA in the Silicon Valley area.

As a fabless semiconductor manufacturer, Pyramid designs and supplies integrated circuits including MIL-STD-1750A processors, SRAMs, EEPROMs, FCT/FCT-T logic, and flash memory. Wafers are fabricated at outside foundries—TSMC in Taiwan and LA Semiconductor in the USA—while the company's 10,000-square-foot facility handles wafer testing, ceramic and plastic assembly, environmental testing, electrical testing, burn-in, marking, and quality assurance. The site includes a Class 1000 clean room for hermetic ceramic assembly and supports more than 100 Standard Military Drawings (SMDs). Pyramid also offers custom logic functions, packages, and multi-chip modules with short lead times.

The company serves military, aerospace, industrial, and commercial customers, with a focus on high-longevity applications for legacy military embedded systems. Its products are used in defense and aerospace programs requiring MIL-STD-883 compliance and DLA-qualified manufacturing. Pyramid is the sole source for MIL-STD-1750A processors, which have been field-proven for over 20 years.

Pyramid emphasizes quality as the foundation of customer trust, maintaining ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, a QML-certified manufacturing line per MIL-PRF-38535 Class Q, and laboratory suitability for MIL-STD-883. The company highlights its secure, long-term supply chain, radiation-hardened silicon-on-sapphire devices rated beyond 100 krad, and EEPROMs with greater than 10-year data retention and 100,000-cycle endurance.
